title: Director of Sales Engineering at Celestica Inc. Sees AVC as a Strong Liquid-Cooling Supplier Amid Rising Adoption and Competition
expert: Director of sales engineering at Celestica (current); technical evaluator of AVC cold plates, manifolds and CDUs since 2024
verdict: A Celestica sales-engineering director who has evaluated AVC since 2024 sees supply-reservation premiums of 10% to 30–40% and AVC yields rising, while buyers plan 70/30–80/20 splits that can move to 60/40–50/50 in production.

Nvidia content and share: 🔴 Primary/secondary splits 70/30 or 80/20 can move to 60/40 or 50/50 in mass production (planning examples), vs JPM's ~50% AVC share per project (SB #58861). → Tenet 1 (Nvidia content and share) ↓
🔴 Auras closing in via rumored Thailand capacity, with Cooler Master and Delta also scaling; vs AVC ~30%, Cooler Master ~30% on GB (SB #64467). → Tenet 1 (Nvidia content and share) ↓
ASIC liquid-cooling start: 🟢 AVC custom-ASIC liquid revenue may surpass GPU by 2027 (estimate), consistent with mgmt's ASIC >50% of liquid revenue in 2027 (SB #54848). → Tenet 2 (ASIC ramp) ↑
🟢 Liquid adoption 30% last year to 60% by 2027 (estimate) vs mgmt's >50% penetration in 2027 (SB #65392): consistent.
Gross margin: 🟢 Supply-reservation premiums of 10% to 30–40% when lead times stretch (first-hand), consistent with AVC's cold-plate ASP raises (SB #58857). → Tenet 3 (GM 34%+) ↑

changes: Planning splits 70/30–80/20 moving to 60/40–50/50 vs JPM's ~50% AVC share per project (SB #58861, 2026-09-29): consistent with ~50% in production.
ASIC liquid revenue may pass GPU by 2027 vs mgmt's ASIC >50% of liquid revenue in 2027 (SB #54848): consistent.
Liquid adoption 60% by 2027 vs mgmt's >50% penetration in 2027 (SB #65392): slightly higher.
Reservation premiums 10% to 30–40% vs JPM's AVC ASP raises on switch trays (SB #58857): consistent, pricing firm.
thesis_impact: Tenet 1 (Nvidia content and share): ↓ — buyers plan to cut the primary supplier to 50%–60% in production; Auras, Cooler Master and Delta scaling.
Tenet 2 (ASIC ramp): ↑ — ASIC liquid revenue may pass GPU by 2027.
Tenet 3 (Margin and EPS): ↑ — 10% to 30–40% reservation premiums when lead times stretch.
